data.name: The Mushroom Adventrue:Call of Distant Realms
data.detailed_description:
Perhaps an ordinary day for humans is the tumultuous, magnificent lifetime of a mushroom...

This is the story of a mushroom's adventurous life, showcasing the world of microscopic organisms and the vibrant, colorful ecology from a mushroom's perspective.

The game employs a cutting-edge, ​physiology-driven, environmentally-deep, immersive interactive experience:

  • ​No Traditional UI​ (information is conveyed through biological signs and environmental feedback).

  • ​No Quest Lists​ (replaced by environmental storytelling and dynamic events).

  • ​No Experience or Levels​ (growth is represented through a scar system).

  • ​Unique Mushroom Spore Combat System​ (incorporates collection, tower defense, strategy, and ecological wisdom).

  • ​No Dialogue System​ (emotions are conveyed through biological behaviors, eliminating language barriers).

  • ​Scar Archive System​ (saving mechanism is integrated into the narrative theme—the body is its history).

​Simplified Controls: Traditional WSAD for movement, Left SHIFT for sprinting, Hold F to take root and recover (when health is low, the cap flashes red), Mouse (Left click or Hold to release—'planting' mushrooms, Scroll wheel to switch spore release states—merge/separate). Acquire a variety of skills by automatically absorbing spores from other mushrooms.

​Important Note:

The combat system in The Mushroom Adventrue has been fundamentally redesigned. Players are ​not intended to traditionally defeat enemies. The game emphasizes ​symbiosis, escape, non-violent conflict, and ​deep immersion. Therefore, when encountering an enemy you cannot hit or defeat, ​run away quickly​! As the weakest protagonist in gaming history, your goal is to use every means to protect yourself before the game ends, not to be a hero.

The Mushroom Adventrue achieves the following by eliminating traditional settings:

  • ​Thematic Consistency: All systems serve the core experience of "fungal survival".

  • ​Emotional Immersion: No UI, no reliance on text, allowing players to "become the mushroom".

  • ​Strategic Depth: Simple controls (3 primary keys) give rise to complex ecological interactions.
